description: This file defines an abstract class 'AuditModel' which provides auditing capabilities for entities, including 'createdAt' and 'updatedAt' timestamp fields, along with their getters and setters. It is a base class meant to be extended by other entity classes to automatically handle auditing information using JPA and Spring Data annotations.

classes.name: AuditModel
classes.description: An abstract base class that provides auditing fields 'createdAt' and 'updatedAt' with appropriate JPA and Jackson annotations, meant to be extended by other JPA entity classes.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Returns the creation timestamp of the entity.

methods.name: setCreatedAt
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp of the entity.

methods.name: getUpdatedAt
methods.description: Returns the last updated timestamp of the entity.

methods.name: setUpdatedAt
methods.description: Sets the last updated timestamp of the entity.
